items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Charlie Walp was a real good trumpet player that came from there and his sister Beth played trombone and she played very well.

ctx.x: Were there any others besides those two brothers?

Oh, there were the two brothers and there was a sister, Belle, I don’t think she played anything that I know of. Charlie Walp was a real good trumpet player that came from there and his sister Beth played trombone and she played very well. She and Rob used to play duets all the time.
So, let’s see, who are some of the other players on Buddy’s band that you can recall, there were the Swopes…
